prose.name: Recovery: Ghost Freighter over <Planet>
prose.briefing: A freighter has been drifting dark in orbit over <Planet> for months. Nobody ever came back for her, and the colony below would like to know why.
prose.card: Local Contract. Recover the cargo from the derelict freighter over <Planet> for the colony below. Payment on contract completion.

beats.objective: Recover the medical supplies from the freighter over <Planet>
beats.journal: The colony's medical supplies were still in her hold, and her company reported the whole cargo lost. I've taken a crate of them out, and I need to hand it to the colony's shuttle.
beats.name: Medical Supply Crate
say: Lost with everything aboard, they told us, and they claimed for every crate. Our shuttle's coming up to meet you, so hand it across, and I'll deal with the company myself.

beats.objective: Deliver the supplies to the shuttle
beats.journal: The freighter over <Planet> was never lost. Her company claimed for her cargo and left her drifting. I delivered the colony's medical supplies to their shuttle.
beats._model: A small shuttle static in orbit, not boardable. His or Kim's pick.
beats.name: Colony Shuttle

message.title: Supplies Delivered
message.text: The shuttle takes the crate aboard and turns for the planet below.

say: It's aboard. There are people down here who've been waiting since she went quiet.

broadcast: That freighter was bringing our medical supplies when she went quiet, and the company told us she was lost with everything aboard. She doesn't look lost to me, so get into her hold and see what's still there.
_speech: Angry and precise. The settler voice from 05a and 18a; his ear decides.
